card.line: En-rogel was a spring near Jerusalem that marked a border between Judah and Benjamin, and it was a place of secret messages and a royal feast.

moments.title: A border marker
moments.text: En-rogel is named as a point where the border of Judah ran. It also appears in the border of Benjamin, near the southern slope of the Jebusites. Jerusalem was the city of the Jebusites.

moments.title: Waiting for news
moments.text: Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed at En-rogel because they dared not be seen entering the city. A servant girl brought them news, and they passed it on to King David.

moments.title: Adonijah's feast
moments.text: Adonijah sacrificed sheep, oxen, and fattened calves near the stone of Zoheleth, next to En-rogel. He invited all his royal brothers except Solomon, and all the men of Judah who were servants of the king. He did not invite Nathan or Benaiah.
